nodes.name: Patient-1
nodes.summary:
Patient-1 (born February 24, 1967, case number URO-2026-0001) is managed under an active surveillance protocol for low-risk prostate carcinoma (C61 Prostatakarzinom, Gleason 3+3=6, ISUP 1, cT1c cN0 cM0) at the Urologische Klinik of Klinikum Berlin under the care of Dr. med. Arzt-1. Initial referral occurred on November 6, 2026, due to an elevated PSA of 6,4 ng/ml. Subsequent diagnostics included a November 2026 lab PSA of 6,4 ng/ml, a December 2026 prostate MRI showing PI-RADS 3, and a January 9, 2027 transrectal core needle biopsy confirming adenocarcinoma. An interdisciplinary tumor board on January 23, 2027, recommended active surveillance.
Patient-1 has a total PSA level of 7.5 ng/ml as measured by the laboratory report.

Patient-1 has an active PSA-Wert of 7.5 ng/ml with a stable PSA-Verlauf.

nodes.name: Prostatakarzinom
nodes.summary:
Patient-1 has a diagnosis of C61 Prostatakarzinom (low-risk, active surveillance), staged as cT1c cN0 cM0 with a Gleason score of 3+3=6 (ISUP 1). Total PSA levels were recorded at 6.5 ng/ml on January 23 and 27, 2027; 6.6 ng/ml on April 27, 2027; 6.7 ng/ml on August 22, 2027; 6.8 ng/ml on December 5, 2027; 7.0 ng/ml on May 16, 2028; and 7.2 ng/ml on August 14, 2028. Active surveillance was consistently recommended and continued at routine follow-up evaluations under Dr. med. Arzt-1 at the Urologische Klinik, Klinikum Berlin.
